notes: Stories refined for clearer separation of concerns and stricter integration boundaries. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Implement deterministic freshness evaluation engine with two explicit checks: (1) TTL expiry using configurable policy, and (2) file-level hash drift using SHA-256 comparison against current filesystem state produced by manifest_generator.
change_log.note: Clarified deterministic behavior and separation of checks

change_log.value: Embed freshness validation into execution entry points (dev_pipeline, sync_to_mongo, brain_runner pre-execution) with strict gating: block execution until manifest is regenerated when stale.
change_log.note: Strengthened enforcement semantics (blocking vs passive trigger)

change_log.value: Expose internal freshness contract via callable interface returning freshness_state, age_seconds, last_generated, drift_detected, and enforcement_decision for upstream gating logic.
Implement unit and integration tests validating TTL expiry, hash drift detection, blocking behavior, and automatic regeneration across dev_pipeline and brain_runner execution paths.
change_log.note: Added blocking validation to align with S3 change
